name: Star Crossed
source:
Clara, a kindly barmaid with a secret identity. Laila, a policewoman determined to uphold justice in a corrupt city. As their paths collide, the lines between ally and adversary become obscured.

Clara is torn between her duty to rebel against the Father, the regime's leader, and the unexpected emotions within her heart. Laila, committed to her duty, is drawn to the mysterious barmaid in ways that may challenge her convictions.

Will Clara follow her heart or will duty prevail over desire? Explore the depths of love, betrayal, and sacrifice in this visual novel where the choices you make will shape their destiny!

[Edited from [url=https://crescendo.itch.io/star-crossed]itch.io[/url]]
